name: Miss Chocolate Eater
source:
A very short visual novel about a lonely, bitter woman running a dusty shop meeting the most beautiful women she's ever met, who are also taking her beloved chocolates.

An entry to the [url=https://itch.io/jam/o2a2-again]One of Any Asset (O2A2) 2021[/url] jam.
translation:
一部极短篇视觉小说。经营着一家落满灰尘的小店的孤独刻薄女人，遇见了自己见过最美丽的几位女性，可她们也正在拿走她心爱的巧克力。

这是[url=https://itch.io/jam/o2a2-again]2021年One of Any Asset（O2A2）[/url]游戏创作活动的参赛作品。
